class.name: CharacterModeler
class.brief_description: Tier 2 studio workspace for character blueprints and apparel.
class.description: Organizes [CharacterBlueprintResource] assets under the [b]Blueprints[/b] tab (hosting [CharacterMorphSliderPanel]) and [CharacterApparelResource] assets under the [b]Apparel[/b] tab, paired with a live [RuntimeInspector] dock.

method.name: open_character_resource
method.description: Opens or focuses the shared [CharacterModeler] window and loads [param resource].
